appraisals.name: Power in society
appraisals.description: Feminists argue that women are disempowered in society, as they get lower pay and get assumed to be lower-ranking, and because the most powerful people are usually men and so the decisions of powerful people reflect male concerns more than female concerns. Meanwhile, others argue that society actually empowers women more than it empowers men, through e.g. diversity hiring. In net, do you think these factors would be better for you as a woman or better for you as a man?
responses: This would benefit me a lot as a woman
This would benefit me somewhat as woman
This doesn't have much net effect on me
This benefits me somewhat as a man
This benefits me a lot as a man

appraisals.name: Male femininity
appraisals.description: A lot of places consider it weird or bad for men to wear dresses, skirts, makeup or nail polish, or for them to be excessively focused on fashion, and they might expect men to oppose homosexuality. If you are a man in such a place who wants to wear dresses or similar, then you might feel that this is bad for you. In net, to what extent do you find opposition to male femininity like this to harm you as a man?

appraisals.description: The male body has certain traits that could be considered "coarse". For instance, men have more body hair than women, are more smelly than women, men grow beards, have fat on their bellies rather than more evenly spread, and men's penises are an external organ which fills out space in their underwear. appraisals.description: Certain things about the male body are very practical. For instance, men are stronger and so can more easily carry things, and men's penis makes it easy to pee standing, plus it makes it easy to orgasm. However, the flipside might be that people have higher expectations for men to help with physical matters, or that you'd pee in urinals where you are relatively exposed rather than in good privacy in toilet cubicles. appraisals.description: Women have monthly periods, where they bleed and can have cramps and even emotional fluctuations. appraisals.name: Physical vulnerability
appraisals.description: Most women are much weaker and smaller than most men. The typical man could totally and brutally beat up the typical woman.
